title: matucana aurantiaca subsp. fruticosa
intro: Matucana aurantiaca subsp. fruticosa, commonly known as the "Golden Pincushion Cactus", is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of gastrointestinal issues. Matucana aurantiaca subsp. fruticosa contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
